_comment: Which agents /task-pipeline may use, in which role, for which deliverable kinds. tp.py enforces it. Agents not listed here are never used.

code-author.use: production code that makes the task's tests pass

test-author.use: tests written first and observed failing (red)

kb-author.use: knowledge-base articles and their index.md files

doc-author.use: READMEs, guides, references, runbooks, research write-ups

tutorial-author.use: hands-on tutorials whose commands are actually run

codebase-researcher.use: recon: a bounded structure question the survey cannot answer; author: code research deliverables

domain-researcher.use: recon: a bounded external-technology question; author: external research deliverables

atlassian-liaison.use: recon: read named Jira/Confluence items; author: approved Jira/Confluence writes

github-liaison.use: recon: read named issues/PRs/CI; author: approved GitHub writes

doc-reviewer.use: accuracy and clarity review of documents

code-reviewer.use: bugs and correctness in a code diff

test-reviewer.use: whether new tests prove the acceptance criteria

architecture-reviewer.use: structure of a code change with real architectural impact; never documents

ux-reviewer.use: a user-facing CLI/TUI/UI surface the task creates or changes
